title: pquality
description: Items can have an associated quality that affects their stats
body:
**pquality** adds a system of item quality similar to Factorio: Space Age or Stardew Valley.

By default, most vanilla items that can't be placed can have quality, but the [system](https://github.com/petrolpark/Create-Library/wiki/Flags) is completely generic. Add quality to items by adding them to the `petrolpark:flaggable` item tag.

### Effects of Quality
- Items have more durability
- Food replenishes more hunger and saturation, and has gives longer, stronger and higher-chance effects (or the opposite for negative effects)
- Weapons deal more damage, tools have faster mining speed and armor gives more protection, among most other [Attributes](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Attribute)
- Potions last longer
- Villagers give you more items and gain more XP
- Anvil repair materials repair more durability
- Firework Rockets propel Elytra further
- Fuels burn for longer
- Bundles have more space
- Eyes of Ender have a smaller chance of breaking
- Bottles o' Enchanting give more XP

### Obtaining Quality Items
- The Enhancement Enchantment adds a chance for quality drops when blocks are mined, mobs are killed and fish are fished, depending on the player's experience level
  - This is not found in the Enchanting Table or loot chests by default
- Crafting, Brewing, Smelting, Smithing etc enough quality items together produces a Quality product
- Example command to add Quality to held item: `/petrolpark flag @s pquality:bronze_quality`

### Compatibility
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create):
  - Quality machines have a lower stress impact
  - Quality is preserved through most Create recipe types
- [Petrol's Parts](https://modrinth.com/mod/petrols-parts)
  - Some quality machines have lower stress impact
  - Quality Movements can store more rotations

All of these features can be configured (through datapacks or NeoForge configs), so you can disable any you want individually. You can also set a config to only show the Quality icons if you are holding shift.

If you think this does not seem like a large set of features, that is because **pquality** is more aimed at modpack creators who can hook into the Quality system. The default Quality levels are Bronze (+10% to most stats), Silver (+25%), Gold (+50%), Diamond (+75%) and Netherite (+100%), but you can define any Quality levels you want with a datapack.
